point_near_origin.why: B10: a stop with no coordinate that something references is published at 0,0 and named in a warning, rather than at a plausible centroid that would hide it. QBN/QBS are the two. Goes to 0 when D3 or D7 gives them coordinates.

stop_time_with_arrival_before_previous_d.why: B25: Z03536, the same record .github/validator-baseline.json accepts. A pass is published between the calls either side of it, so passing points bring none of their own: one reading later than the call after it is a bug in ScheduleBuilder's onPublicClock, not a timetable to accept.
